EPS for NetEase, Inc. (NTES) Expected At $2.36 Posted by Darrin Black 25 am
Analysts expect NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) to report $2.36 EPS on February, 6.They anticipate $0.87 EPS change or 58.39 % from last quarter’s $1.49 EPS. NTES’s profit would be $309.94 million giving it 24.34 P/E if the $2.36 EPS is correct. After having $1.80 EPS previously, NetEase, Inc.’s analysts see 31.11 increased 4.01% or $8.85 $229.75. About 1.15M shares traded or 30.56% up from the average. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) has declined 26.07% downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.07% the S&P500. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) Ratings Coverage
Among 6 analysts covering NetEase ( NASDAQ:NTES ), 5 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 83% are positive. NetEase had 9 analyst reports since July 30, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was upgraded by Morgan Stanley on Thursday, December 6 to “Overweight”. Nomura maintained the shares of NTES in report on Friday, August 10 with “Buy” rating. On Friday, November 16 the stock rating was maintained by Barclays Capital with “Equal-Weight”. The rating was maintained by Nomura with “Buy” on Friday, November 16. The stock of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) earned “Equal-Weight” rating by Barclays Capital on Monday, July 30. The firm earned “Overweight” rating on Friday, August 10 by JP Morgan. The rating was maintained by Barclays Capital on Thursday, August 30 with “Equal-Weight”. Jefferies upgraded NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) on Friday, September 21 to “Buy” rating. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, December 19 by UBS.
NetEase, Inc. operates an interactive online community in the People's Republic of China. $30.17 billion. The firm operates through Online Game Services; Advertising Services; and E-mail, E-commerce and Others divisions. It has a 34.45 P/E ratio. It offers PC-client massively multi-player online role-playing games and mobile games; and distributes its point cards to gamers.
